Playbook.name: Windows — Potential SharpRDP Behavior - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: An incoming RDP connection was followed within a minute by a RunMRU registry entry set to cmd/powershell/taskmgr/tsclient and then process execution - the SharpRDP authenticated-RDP-command-execution pattern. Triage question: is this SharpRDP lateral movement, or normal interactive RDP admin use?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: SharpRDP executes commands over RDP without a full interactive session, a stealthy lateral-movement technique.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Windows Security + Sysmon + PowerShell logs via Elastic Agent (verified live). Sysmon event.code 1=process(command_line/parent populated), 11=file, 13/12=registry(registry.path populated); process.code_signature NOT collected.

Signal.Name: SharpRDP pattern
Signal.Details: incoming RDP -> RunMRU set to a shell -> execution within 1m.

Input.name: $hostname
Input.description: Target host of the RDP + execution.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the evidence story, not any single fact - see ClassificationGuidance.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the RDP-then-execution pattern is SharpRDP lateral movement or normal RDP admin use.

Step.name: RDP source and the RunMRU/execution that followed
Step.Purpose: Confirm the sequence: an RDP logon then a shell launched via RunMRU is the SharpRDP signature.
Step.Query: FROM logs-system.security-* | WHERE host.name == "$hostname" AND event.code == "4624" AND winlog.event_data.LogonType == "10" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours | EVAL src = COALESCE(TO_STRING(source.ip), "local") | STATS logons = COUNT(*), users = VALUES(winlog.event_data.TargetUserName), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp) BY src | SORT logons DESC | LIMIT 10
Step.AnalystNotes: Identify the RDP source and account. Then check the RunMRU write and process execution below - the tight sequence (RDP then shell within 1m) distinguishes SharpRDP from a human who logs in and works over minutes.

Step.name: Shell execution via RunMRU on the host
Step.Purpose: A cmd/powershell launched right after the RDP logon confirms command execution over RDP.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND process.name RLIKE "(?i)(cmd|powershell|pwsh|taskmgr).*" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 hours | KEEP @timestamp, process.name, process.parent.name, process.command_line, user.name | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: A shell spawned by explorer/RunMRU immediately after the RDP logon, running commands, supports SharpRDP. A human working interactively spreads activity over time.

Node.Condition: An RDP logon immediately followed by RunMRU-launched shell command execution, from an unusual source.
A normal interactive RDP admin session with organic, time-spread activity.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-SHARPRDP-SEQ, INV-02-SHARPRDP-EXEC to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A normal interactive RDP administration session.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the admin session; close as benign_activity.
Isolate target and source; open IR; scope lateral movement.
Reset credentials used; hunt the source's other RDP targets.

Misconfiguration.Definition: An RDP automation tool driving RunMRU by design.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the activity on the host; if malicious indicators, isolate the host.
Identify the responsible account/process and its origin.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate the host; capture volatile evidence; hunt the same pattern across the estate.
Reset credentials used on the host if compromise is confirmed.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Remediate the root cause; add/verify EDR coverage; apply relevant hardening.

QualityChecks.Check: Confirm the required telemetry (Sysmon/Security auditing) is present on the host.
Tune known-benign administrative sources via exceptions, not by disabling the rule.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Host contained and triaged; root cause eradicated; estate swept; findings recorded.
